source_document.body:
A supply chain degree can prepare students for work in purchasing, inventory, transportation , warehousing , and operations. U.S. colleges offer several ways to study these subjects, from undergraduate majors to master's degrees and supply chain concentrations within broader business programs.
The directory below brings together degree programs across the country, organized by state. Some award a degree specifically in supply chain management or logistics , while others offer a concentration, emphasis, or specialization within business administration, management, or marketing.
Use the university links to compare admission requirements, tuition, and study formats. The location column identifies the school or teaching site, with fully online options identified where noted. This is a selected directory, not a list of every U.S. program.
Updated October 2026. Program information was reviewed against each school's website. Students should confirm current requirements and availability directly with each university.
Degree programs
University | Degree or concentration | Location | Program notes

Auburn University | B.S.B.A. in Supply Chain Management | Auburn, AL | Combines logistics and operations management.

South Dakota State University | M.S. in Operations Management, Supply Chain Management specialization | Brookings, SD | Graduate specialization in supply chain management.
Middle Tennessee State University | B.B.A. in Supply Chain Management | Murfreesboro, TN | Standalone bachelor's major.
University of Memphis | B.B.A. in Supply Chain Management | Memphis, TN | Covers supply management, operations, logistics, and supply chain analytics.
University of Tennessee, Knoxville | B.S. in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management major | Knoxville, TN | An undergraduate supply chain major at the Haslam College of Business.
Texas A&M University | B.B.A. in Supply Chain Management | College Station, TX | SCM majors can apply to Mays' 4+1 bachelor's/master's programs.

University of Utah | B.S. in Operations and Supply Chain | Salt Lake City, UT | Covers process flows, quality, and inventory management .

West Virginia University | B.S.B.A. in Supply Chain Management | Morgantown, WV | An undergraduate supply chain major.
